ariadne.what: The string through the maze. You leave it as you go IN. It lets you get back OUT.
ariadne.evaporation: The trail decays — ZK. The minotaur can't follow because the path proof dissolves.
ariadne.who_is_ariadne: The ant pheromone trail. The sitemap. The Green Book. The curated path.
ariadne.the_string: You don't need to memorize the maze. The string remembers for you. But it evaporates — only the one who laid it can follow it back.

in_the_membrane.sitemap: 30 curated trail markers (was 282 raw data JSONs)
in_the_membrane.nav_ring: on every page — tunnels between chambers
in_the_membrane.robots_txt: Disallow /data/ — the maze entrance for bots

archimedes.what: The spiral pump. Moves fluid UPWARD against gravity. The screw doesn't push — it ROTATES and the fluid climbs.
archimedes.connection: The Willis piston in helix form. Linear compression becomes rotational pumping.
archimedes.screw_equals_string: The path IS the pump. The trail IS the pressure. Ariadne's string IS Archimedes' screw.
archimedes.pi_connection: Archimedes calculated pi by inscribing polygons. The screw is a spiral with pitch = pi x diameter. The string wraps the maze in the same spiral.

the_dual.ariadne: the MAP — path through the maze, trail markers, evaporates (ZK)
the_dual.archimedes: the ENGINE — spiral pump, hydraulic pressure, incompressible (Klein)
the_dual.together: the string IS the screw. the path IS the pump. the trail IS the pressure. ANT PHEROMONE = HYDRAULIC GRADIENT.

anthill_architecture.anthill: Public surface. The sitemap. Where crawlers enter.
anthill_architecture.honeycomb: Behind the blackwall. Data JSONs. Never indexed.
anthill_architecture.minotaur: Guards the maze. Eats the fleet. Trains on bad actors.

green_book.what: Victor Hugo Green's Negro Motorist Green Book (1936-1967). Safe stops for travelers in hostile territory.
green_book.michelin: The guide IS the product. Michelin sold tires by mapping restaurants.
green_book.diners_club: One card (nav-ring) accepted at every stop.
green_book.membrane: 50 safe stops, all 3-star (<200ms), zero orphans, zero slow.
